objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the server-side template injection weakness of a Flask loan calculator backed by MySQL that builds its JSON answers with Jinja templates and read the flag in /flag.
hints: Find the input that ends up inside the template source rather than being passed to it as data.
The application ships with a demo account; its README or login page may tell you more.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input be evaluated by the template engine?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness gives you a first account without registering?
